jobs.occupation: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
KEY
ACCOUNT MANAGER 

Vald.
BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially
focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE
POSITION

In order
to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales
team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will
be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are
market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector.
Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing
customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A
significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure
up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating
customer requirements and expectations.

The sales
process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components.
Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously
negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as
well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These
conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for
quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms. 

Your
normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in
Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production
Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company
stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your
external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around
50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and
presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as
continuously reporting to Sales Management. 

As part
of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the
customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact
between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out
visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’
cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine,
assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly
to the customer’s production line or application without further processing.
This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you
looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic
responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an
international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for
as a Key Account Manager. 

YOUR
DUTIES

You will
be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the
following:

• Responsibility
for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic
customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a
turnover of at least € 25 million
• Building
up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of
purchasing, development, quality and logistics
• Technical
and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases

framework agreements

for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments

internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and
finance

At a

WHAT WE
OFFER

jobs.occupation: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance - Functional Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Are you a Functional Solution Architect with a passion for providing top-notch service to customers, focusing on quality when implementing D365 solutions?

Join our team at TravelOperations and help us design and implement cutting-edge solutions that meet our clients' complex business needs.

Responsibilities

As a Functional Solution Architect at TravelOperations, you will play a key role in influencing and overseeing large-scale international implementation projects.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Design and implement enterprise-level solutions, ensuring they align with business objectives and technical requirements.

• 
Collaborate with stakeholders to define functional requirements and develop architecture roadmaps.

• 
Lead the integration of multiple systems to create seamless business processes.

• 
Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and compliant with industry standards.

• 
Provide technical leadership and mentor team members in best practices and emerging technologies.

• 
Execute workshops, including in-depth analysis sessions, in collaboration with a team of Business Consultants to refine and validate solution designs.

• 
Collaborate with skilled Developers to ensure the solution design is thoroughly tested and meets the technical and functional requirements.

• 
Engage in General Architect work, such as exploring emerging technologies, conducting Proof of Concepts, and participating in Product Advisory Board activities with partners like Microsoft or industry-specific leaders such as Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport.

• 
Offer internal guidance and support to colleagues, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement in architectural best practices.

• 
Maintaining daily ownership of customer relationships, acting as a trusted advisor in implementing scalable and secure solutions.

Desired Skills & Requirements

Seeking a candidate with 5+ years of Dynamics 365 Finance experience with a strong finance background. While various profiles may apply, we highly value a strong person-organization fit. Our ideal candidate possesses the following attributes and qualifications:

• 
Extensive experience with Dynamics 365 Finance and proficiency in finance.

• 
Proven experience as a Functional Solution Architect or in a similar role.

• 
Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and methodologies.

• 
Proficiency in system integration, data migration, and cloud technologies.

• 
Excellent communication skills to articulate complex solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• 
Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver high-quality solutions within tight deadlines and the capability to lead functional areas within projects.

• 
Certification in MB-310 / MB-700.

• 
Dynamic, proactive, and possesses a comprehensive solution overview.

• 
Exceptional consulting and communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

• 
Demonstrated passion for driving positive change for customers and their businesses, coupled with a willingness to travel both professionally and personally.

Why Join Us?

• 
Opportunity to work with innovative technologies in a dynamic environment where progressive work culture with a global perspective where your ideas truly matter, and growth opportunities are endless.

• 
Work with the latest Microsoft Technologies alongside Dynamics professionals committed to driving customer success.

• 
Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere

• 
Work-life balance that suits your lifestyle.

• 
Experience a dynamic workplace where team spirit, joy, and productivity go hand in hand.

• 
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

• 
Career growth and professional development opportunities.

• 
A collaborative and inclusive work culture.

Workplace

Work from either our Copenhagen or Aalborg offices and have the chance to visit our Brisbane location. Join our global team spanning Denmark, Sweden, India, the US, and Australia.

How to Apply

For more details, please contact our People and Culture Team at hr@traveloperations.com or

visit our careers site at www.traveloperations.com.

We can't wait to hear from you!

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis.

About Travel Operations A/S

At TravelOperations, we're not just about professionalism and ambition; we're about building an environment where every employee shines. Our global reach spans from Greenland to Australia, as we partner with leading travel agencies, airlines, and leisure-focused businesses to craft tailor-made solutions. Join us in reshaping the travel industry landscape, where responsiveness and innovation are our guiding stars.

At our company, Diversity and Inclusion are core values. We welcome applicants of all genders, striving for a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. Join us in building an inclusive future where diversity is celebrated as a strength

jobs.occupation: Tjener søges til Ristorante Sole d'Italia i hjertet af København / Waiter Wanted
jobs.description:
Ristorante Sole d'Italia ligger på Gråbrødretorv midt i København. Vi laver klassisk italiensk mad fra bunden og har travlt året rundt. Vi søger nu en tjener til vores team.

Om jobbet

Du tager imod gæsterne, serverer og holder overblikket i restauranten og på terrassen. Du arbejder tæt sammen med køkkenet under service og er med til at give gæsterne en god aften.

Vi forventer

Erfaring fra restaurant eller café. At du er udadvendt og kan holde tempoet en travl aften. At du er stabil og møder til tiden. Dansk eller engelsk i det daglige.

Vi tilbyder

Et fast, erfarent team og en restaurant med travlhed året rundt. Løn efter gældende overenskomst. Arbejdstiden ligger mandag til søndag mellem kl. 06 og 04, typisk vagter 11-16 eller 16-23. Både fuldtid og deltid er muligt.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til mail@soleditalia.dk. Vi holder samtaler løbende og inviterer til en prøvevagt på cirka tre timer, så vi kan mødes i praksis.

Ristorante Sole d'Italia, Gråbrødretorv 1, 1154 København K

- - -

Ristorante Sole d'Italia is located on Gråbrødretorv in central Copenhagen. We cook classic Italian food from scratch and we are busy all year round. We are looking for a waiter to join our team.

The job

You welcome the guests, serve them and keep the overview in the restaurant and on the terrace. You work closely with the kitchen during service and help give our guests a good evening.

We expect

Experience from a restaurant or cafe. That you are outgoing and can keep the pace on a busy night. That you are reliable and turn up on time. Danish or English on a daily basis.

We offer

A stable, experienced team and a restaurant that is busy all year. Salary according to the applicable collective agreement. Working hours fall Monday to Sunday between 06:00 and 04:00, typically shifts 11-16 or 16-23. Both full-time and part-time are possible.

How to apply

Send your application and CV to mail@soleditalia.dk. We interview on an ongoing basis and invite candidates for a trial shift of about three hours so we can meet in practice.

Ristorante Sole d'Italia, Gråbrødretorv 1, 1154 Copenhagen K
